memory_candidates.title: Beta-robust tableau termination measure: base-3 exponential over branches
memory_candidates.body: For a fuel-based tableau loop where beta rules duplicate a whole branch into 2 children, an additive count measure grows. A sum-over-branches Nat measure must satisfy f(C) > 2*f(C-1) to absorb a balanced 2-way split, forcing exponential growth; base 2 fails (2*2^(C-1)+1 > 2^C), base 3 works (3^a0+3^a1+1 <= 3^C for a0,a1 <= C-1, C>=1). Use Phi = sum over branches of 3^(per-branch unexpanded-complexity). Keeps the Nat-fuel induction intact and makes the fuel=0 case a contradiction (Phi=0 only when no branches).

memory_candidates.title: Mathlib has Dershowitz-Manna multiset order
memory_candidates.body: Mathlib.Data.Multiset.DershowitzManna provides Multiset.IsDershowitzMannaLT with Multiset.wellFounded_isDershowitzMannaLT and a WellFoundedRelation instance. Exact model for 'remove x, add finitely many < x' steps, but using it for a fuel-based recursion requires a termination_by/decreasing_by function refactor.
